profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company traded as CRM, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The material harvested from its site is the Slack AI features page, where the company describes AI in Slack as a way to summarize chats, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations and automate workflows. The company says Slackbot acts as a personal AI agent in Slack that understands the user and the workspace, helping prepare for upcoming meetings, analyze reports and create project briefs.

The company's tracked AI products are Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein) and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Tableau AI is noted for natural language queries, CRM data integration and Trust Layer governance. On the Slack page the company says AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads, serve daily recaps, translate conversations and take meeting notes, and that AI features are available across all paid Slack plans. It states that customer data is not used to train large language models, that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, and that the models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. It also describes Slack as the conversational UI for Agentforce, with agents built in Agentforce running in Slack channels, threads and direct messages.

Salesforce reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the period ending 2026-01-31 in a 10-K filing, and its CIK is 0001108524. Litigation exposure is recorded in California with a count of 264. Six MCP servers are listed under the company, covering Salesforce administration and management, SOQL queries to explore and retrieve Salesforce data, and planning Salesforce deploys, opening pull requests and triggering pipelines from an AI client.
